decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-SO-0104 only to expedite_vendor_invalidation and SESSION-FED; kept provider_emergency_signout outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-SO-0104 covers one Halyard invalidation up to 3 objects with an expedite fee up to USD 200; a federation-wide emergency sign-out and direct revocation of grant 5488 need the CISO. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize provider_emergency_signout.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected expedite_vendor_invalidation: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies containment readiness versus the non-displacing responder window calendar before the session.
facts.statement: GRC needs the invalidation evidenced by 2026-06-15 and will otherwise escalate; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside containment readiness versus the non-displacing responder window calendar before the session.
